fixed_findings.title: Exchange accepted submit could be durably recorded only after the write
fixed_findings.resolution: Persist SUBMITTING, deterministic client order ID, actor, and full intent before POST; restart queries only and never blind-resubmits.

fixed_findings.title: Arm token could self-authorize by deriving the expected digest from the same input
fixed_findings.resolution: Require an independently provisioned SHA256 digest and bind run ID to actor.

fixed_findings.title: Authenticated HTTP transport followed redirects
fixed_findings.resolution: Disable redirects and require exact approved HTTPS root endpoints.

fixed_findings.title: Crashed dangerous control operations could remain permanently in progress
fixed_findings.resolution: Add durable lease owner/expiry with same-actor, same-payload stale recovery and H3-031/H3-032 migrations.

fixed_findings.title: Installation failures could leave a partially upgraded source tree
fixed_findings.resolution: Transactional installer records replaced/new files and automatically rolls back on any failed check.

fixed_findings.title: Integrity-conflict retry session did not commit a recovered stale lease
Embedded report hash semantics were ambiguous
fixed_findings.resolution: Use canonical payload SHA256 inside the report and a detached final-file SHA256 generated by the installer.

fixed_findings.title: Legacy journals gained an actor column but old rows had no safe replay policy
fixed_findings.resolution: Allow zero-network replay only for legacy COMPLETED rows; active unbound rows require manual recovery.

known_non_blocking_items: Online Binance Testnet validation-only and submit-cancel are not executed by the offline installer.
The existing Starlette/httpx TestClient deprecation warning requires coordinated dependency governance, not an isolated package upgrade.
Mainnet live trading remains locked and was not tested or enabled.
